# OWASP Core Rule Set 4.30.0

The files in `rules/` are an unmodified subset of the [OWASP CRS v4.30.0 release](https://github.com/coreruleset/coreruleset/tree/v4.30.0), distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. This subset contains request initialization, the rule families mapped to OpenFlare attack protection categories, and their data files.

Archive [v4.30.0.tar.gz](https://codeload.github.com/coreruleset/coreruleset/tar.gz/refs/tags/v4.30.0) SHA-256 `a4bb3688ef6205b64471a9ccbf0d7b024eb8edf39b97c6f6c0006e7a948f8550`.
